songs.name: song-slow-burn
songs.title: Slow Burn
songs.line: A slow one in G. Twelve bars, four times round, the band leaning back.
songs.sections: Head (bar 1), Second time (bar 13), Sax solo (bar 25), Out chorus (bar 37)

songs.name: song-slow-burn-short
songs.title: Slow Burn Short
songs.line: The slow one in G, once round. Twelve bars and the stop.
songs.sections: Head (bar 1)

songs.name: song-boogie-shoes
songs.title: Boogie Shoes
songs.line: A jump blues in C. Walking bass, chanks on two and four, a riff you'll be humming.
songs.sections: Head (bar 1), The riff (bar 13), Shout chorus (bar 25), Piano solo (bar 37), Head again (bar 49), Out chorus (bar 61)

songs.name: song-pearl-street
songs.title: Pearl Street
songs.line: A Texas shuffle in E. A boogie bass, a fat backbeat, and a stop-time chorus where the sax talks.
songs.sections: Head (bar 1), Snare in (bar 13), Stop time (bar 25), Sax solo (bar 37), Out chorus (bar 49)

songs.name: song-dockery
songs.title: Dockery
songs.line: A Delta blues in A. One guitar, a foot on the floor, and the voice alone in the stops.
songs.sections: Crossroads (bar 1), Verse (bar 13), Slide (bar 25), Last verse (bar 37)

songs.name: song-friars-point
songs.title: Friars Point
songs.line: The fast one. A boogie thumb on the low strings, the slide hammering triplets up top, the foot going.
songs.sections: Head (bar 1), Verse (bar 13), Slide (bar 25), Verse (bar 37), Out (bar 49)

songs.name: song-halsted
songs.title: Halsted
songs.line: The loud one with a band. An electric riff, a rolling piano, a stop-time chorus.
songs.sections: Head (bar 1), Verse (bar 13), Piano (bar 25), Stop time (bar 37), Guitar (bar 49), Head (bar 61), Out (bar 73)

songs.name: song-mclemore
songs.title: McLemore
songs.line: The guitar and the piano trading. One riff in unison, stings, a piano chorus, the breaks.
songs.sections: Head (bar 1), Verse (bar 13), Piano (bar 25), Guitar (bar 37), Out (bar 49)

songs.name: song-blue-lantern-white
songs.title: Blue Lantern II
songs.line: The minor blues in D, one riff in one hand on the white keys. Level 1's song.
songs.sections: Head (bar 1), Snare in (bar 13), Sax solo (bar 25), Out chorus (bar 37)
uses: Level 1 (White keys) goal: the melody on Medium for an A
the band under Level 1's improv "Improvise on the white keys" in Scales (A minor) (the melody left out for the solo)

songs.name: song-maxwell-street-five
songs.title: Maxwell Street II
songs.line: Chicago blues in A, the horn on five notes: A C D E G. Level 2's song.
songs.sections: Stop time (bar 1), Snare in (bar 13), Shuffle (bar 25), Out (bar 37)
uses: Level 2 (Five notes) goal: the melody on Medium for an A
the band under Level 2's improv "Improvise on five notes" in Scales (A minor) (the melody left out for the solo)

songs.name: song-maxwell-street
songs.title: Maxwell Street
songs.line: Chicago blues in A. Eight bars of stop time, the band slamming the riff, the voice in the gaps, then it swings.
songs.sections: Stop time (bar 1), Snare in (bar 13), Shuffle (bar 25), Out (bar 37)

songs.name: song-blue-lantern
songs.title: Blue Lantern
songs.line: A minor blues in D. Rhodes, a sixteenth hat, the sax taking its time.
songs.sections: Head (bar 1), Snare in (bar 13), Sax solo (bar 25), Out chorus (bar 37)

songs.name: song-halbschatten
songs.title: Halbschatten
songs.line: Dub techno at 122, four minutes. One chord stab into a tape echo and a hall, a pad, a lead that arrives late.
songs.sections: Dust (bar 1), Kick (bar 9), Bass (bar 17), Hats (bar 25), Full (bar 33), Clap (bar 41), Break (bar 49), The lead (bar 57), Shaker (bar 65), Open (bar 73), Lead again (bar 81), One chord (bar 89), Thinning (bar 97), Low (bar 105), Out (bar 113)

songs.name: song-gezeiten
songs.title: Gezeiten
songs.line: Dub techno at 116, four minutes. A bell on five white keys from the first bar, an off-beat chord that planes over a ground that never moves.
songs.sections: Still water (bar 1), Kick (bar 9), Bass (bar 17), Hats (bar 25), First tide (bar 33), Ebb (bar 41), Flood (bar 49), Shaker (bar 57), Crest (bar 65), High water (bar 73), One chord (bar 81), Thinning (bar 89), Low (bar 97), Out (bar 105)

songs.name: song-gegenlicht
songs.title: Gegenlicht
songs.line: Techno at 128, four minutes. One acid line on white keys, a kick and its rumble, three clocks against each other.
songs.sections: Light (bar 1), Rumble (bar 9), Toms (bar 17), Acid (bar 25), Clap (bar 33), Rim (bar 41), Break (bar 49), Motif B (bar 57), Ride (bar 65), Shaker (bar 73), The line alone (bar 89), Return (bar 93), Thinning (bar 105), Fading (bar 113), Out (bar 121)

songs.name: song-hypnotist
songs.title: Hypnotist
songs.line: Minimal techno at 127. Clicks and rims, a rolling sub, one bleep that never lets go.
songs.sections: Intro (bar 1), Pulse (bar 9), Bleep (bar 17), Break (bar 41), Full (bar 49), Out (bar 73)

songs.name: song-hypnotist-2
songs.title: Hypnotist II
songs.line: Minimal techno at 127. The same room, a new bleep: three keys turning against the kick.
songs.sections: Intro (bar 1), Pulse (bar 9), Bleep (bar 17), Break (bar 41), Full (bar 49), Out (bar 73)

songs.name: song-warm-nine
songs.title: Warm Nine
songs.line: Deep house at 121. Ninth chords pushed ahead of the beat, a bass that walks root, octave, fifth, crackle on top.
songs.sections: Intro (bar 1), Groove (bar 9), Hook (bar 25), Lift (bar 41), Hook again (bar 49), Out (bar 69)

songs.name: song-abyss
songs.title: Abyss
songs.line: Dub techno at 117. One chord stab into the chamber, breathing, drifting from D to C and back.
songs.sections: Intro (bar 1), Deep (bar 9), Drift (bar 25), Abyss (bar 41), Deep again (bar 49), Out (bar 69)

songs.name: song-abyss-ref
songs.title: Abyss Reference
songs.line: The 16 bars Claude made as the target for Abyss, exactly as made: kick, hats, sub, the stab into the chamber. Nothing added.
songs.sections: Intro (bar 1), Deep (bar 5), Abyss (bar 13), Deep again (bar 15)

Scales (A minor) (29 steps, 13 jams, 60–72 bpm; some steps move it to F, G)

bands.name: Minor blues in A
uses: Minor Chords (28 steps, 14 jams, 60–70 bpm; some steps move it to E♭ minor, E minor, F minor, F♯ minor, G minor, A♭ minor, B♭ minor, B minor, C minor, C♯ minor, D minor)
